Lydia: Shor's bones, that chill from the Thane's spell is biting deeper than a frostbite spider's fangs.
(The location is now Solitude.) (Characters nearby (from nearest to furthest): Serana, Daegon, Lydia, Horse, chicken)

Blaise: I've already mucked out three stalls this morning. At least the horses are happy with the clear sky. Haafingar Guard: Aye, a fine morning for the capital. Makes my patrol along the wall almost pleasant. No rain soaking through the chainmail for once.

Blaise: I wonder what it's like to be up on that wall all day. Do you ever get bored just walking back and forth? Haafingar Guard: Bored? Not with the threat of wolves, bandits, and worse lurking outside the gates. Every step keeps the people safe.

Blaise: The rain makes the torch flicker funny. Does it ever go out on you when you're patrolling? Haafingar Guard: Aye, sometimes it does. That's when you learn to keep a spare in your pack, or find a dry spot quick. But this fog tonight makes me keep my eyes and ears open even more.

Blaise: Are there really wolves that come this close to the city? I've heard stories from the other stable hands. Haafingar Guard: Close enough to snatch a stray chicken or a careless traveler. You stay near the torch and the stables, you'll be fine.

Blaise: I know every chicken in Katla's coop by name. If a wolf ever got one, I'd be the one to find the feathers. Do you ever get to leave Solitude, or is it just the wall and the gate every day? Haafingar Guard: Most days it's the wall and the gate, aye. But sometimes they send us out on patrol to the farms, or to check trade caravans. It's a good life, serving the Jarl and keeping the people safe. Better than sleeping in a stable, I'd wager.

(The location is now Solitude.) (Characters nearby (from nearest to furthest): Lydia, Daegon, Horse, Blaise, Goat) (MJR: That's it? No name or anything?; Gulum-Ei: In this business we rarely deal in names; our identity comes from how much coin we carry. MJR: I think you're lying to me.; Gulum-Ei: Look, that's all I know. I never promised you I'd have all the answers. Now, since our transaction is done, I'll be on my way.)

Solitude Guard: Three in the morning and the streets are still. Not a soul stirring except for that merchant over there. Haafingar Guard: Aye, saw him talking to someone near the Skeever. Late for business, if you ask me. Keeps the city interesting, I suppose. Gulum-Ei: Interesting is one word for it. A merchant's work never truly ends, even under Dibella's moon. The night air is crisp tonight, perfect for a quiet walk.
